decisions.reason: This sewer-related product is close to the firm's existing metal fabrication, coating, and utility-customer knowledge, so management is likely to keep it while learning from early demand.

Public waste bins use general metalworking skills but are relatively distant from the firm's core fluid-handling and industrial offer, making them harder to refine and justify without stronger related knowledge or visible R&D support.
Ground sleeves fit well with the firm's established fabrication capabilities and customer channels, and the multi-model line gives good scope for incremental learning and commercial adjustment.

Cast iron ground sleeves remain related to the new sleeve family, but they are somewhat less aligned with the firm's stated steel and stainless processing strengths, so the risk of later pruning is moderate rather than low.

Steel ground sleeves are highly consistent with the firm's core materials expertise, production equipment, and certification-based quality positioning, so they are the most likely of the new products to stay.
